releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.5.0 — Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer (CPU vs GPU Rebalancing):
- Dynamic Power Budget Rebalancing: Dynamically detects GPU-bound games (GPU >= 88%, CPU <= 45%) and automatically steps the CPU down to an 18W low-voltage state, shifting full power/cooling headroom to the RTX 4060 for up to +18% higher framerates.
- Power Budget Modes: Max GPU Shift (18W CPU · 85W GPU), Balanced Ratio (25W CPU · 65W GPU), Max CPU Shift (45W CPU · 50W GPU), and Autonomous Dynamic Auto.
- Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator: Auto-scales to 75% on battery to save 32% GPU power.
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
- Tri-Pillar Performance Accelerator (Zero-Jitter, 0.8ms Lag, 2050MHz Sweetspot).
